_comment: Armorsmithing Bench recipes. Tier-unlocked recipes consuming Wolf Pelt, Spider Silk, and other crafting materials.

recipes.name: Leather Cap
recipes.description: Craft a lightweight protective cap from cured wolf pelts.

recipes.name: Leather Armor
recipes.description: Craft a sturdy chestpiece from stitched wolf pelts.

recipes.name: Silk Cowl
recipes.description: Weave lightweight spider silk into a protective cowl with leather trimming.

recipes.name: Silk Robe
recipes.description: Weave a dense vestment of spider silk backed by supple wolf hide.

recipes.name: Bone Necklace
recipes.description: Strung monster bones threaded with resilient spider silk into a protective talisman.

recipes.name: Wolf Claw Ring
recipes.description: Carve and bind beast claws and bone into a ring of endurance.

recipes.name: Venom Charm
recipes.description: Stabilize spider venom within an intricate silk weave to craft a protective ward.
